component.name: Epub to Mp3
component.summary: Convert EPUB/PDF ebooks into MP3 audiobooks

description.p: Epub to Mp3 converts EPUB and PDF ebooks into MP3 audiobooks using neural text-to-speech engines. Supports Edge-TTS (cloud), Kokoro (local neural), and Piper (fully offline) with automatic fallback between engines.

ul.li: EPUB and PDF support with full TOC hierarchy
Three TTS engines with automatic fallback
Smart text cache — repeated conversions skip re-parsing
Per-chapter progress tracking and streaming playback

description.p: Align release asset versions across desktop, mobile, and Python builds.
